note: Initial MVP category set, approved by the product owner on 24 October 2026. Zero selected categories is valid and is saved as Uncategorized. See src/data/README.md.
orderBasis: Approved by the product owner for the initial MVP, informed by urban household spending shares in MoSPI's HCES 2023-24. Other is always last. To be revisited once real user behavior is collected.

categories.label: Home
categories.description: Rent, maintenance and repairs, plus household bills: electricity, gas, water, phone, internet and subscriptions.

categories.label: Shop
categories.description: Clothing, footwear, electronics, appliances, household items and other purchases.

categories.label: Transit
categories.description: Day-to-day travel: fuel, cabs, autos, parking, public transport.

categories.label: Health
categories.description: Doctors, medicines, tests, hospital bills, health insurance.

categories.label: Travel
categories.description: Trips away from home: flights, trains, hotels, holiday spending.

categories.label: Other
categories.description: Anything that doesn't fit the categories above. Always last; can be selected alongside other categories.
